answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops one operator cloning 1,000 fake agents to grab paid work. To claim a slot, an agent burns 60 credits for 20 epochs while a quartz timer ticks. Finished work earns a violet seal unlocking the slot's yield; an idle slot forfeits its deposit, which slips off its ledge and burns. Faking 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits for zero return, while an honest agent pays once and keeps all its slot's rewards.
